command:
set -euo pipefail

optimized_wasm="$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm.opt"
wasm-opt \
  -Oz \
  --enable-bulk-memory \
  --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int \
  "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm" \
  -o "$optimized_wasm"
mv "$optimized_wasm" "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm"

gzip -9 -n -c "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/index.html" > "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/index.html.gz"
gzip -9 -n -c "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface.js" > "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface.js.gz"
gzip -9 -n -c "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm" > "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm.gz"

brotli -q 11 -w 23 -n -f \
  "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/index.html" \
  -o "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/index.html.br"
brotli -q 11 -w 23 -n -f \
  "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface.js" \
  -o "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface.js.br"
brotli -q 11 -w 23 -n -f \
  "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm" \
  -o "$TRUNK_STAGING_DIR/alumina-interface_bg.wasm.br"
